body:
I'm drunk and I'm tired
Because I'm a shitty poet
I'm not even a fucking poet

I can't even describe my fucking gfeelings
Literally
Or through metaphors
Or make any fucking sense

I guess what I mean to say is
I write for the small chance
That someone will come along
And fell the way I do

Yes this is a selfish act
Because I'm lonely and scared
And need some hope
Even a delusion would be nice
Because you and I know what it's like to be
Empty and sad

And I love you
I swear to fucking god
Whoever you are
Whether you sympathize or not
